headline: The atomic age begins in Chicago
post_facts: First nuclear reactor, on a squash court
49 people watched, led by Enrico Fermi
They toasted with Chianti in paper cups

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen forty-two... the atomic age began in Chicago.

scenes.label: Chicago Pile-1
scenes.caption: Drawing of the reactor under Stagg Field
scenes.title: A reactor on a squash court
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Scientists built the first nuclear reactor on a squash court... under a football stadium.

scenes.label: people watched the test
scenes.text: [calmly] Forty-nine people watched, led by Enrico Fermi.

scenes.label: Enrico Fermi
scenes.caption: Leader of the Chicago Pile team
scenes.title: A toast in paper cups
scenes.text: [softly] When it worked, they shared a bottle of Chianti from paper cups.

scenes.title: Bombs and power plants followed
scenes.text: [gravely] It led to the atomic bomb, and to nuclear power.

scenes.title: Would you have stood that close?
scenes.text: [gently] Would you have stood that close?
